decision.observation: 3 mph in R, all dots dark. Reverse actually engaged this time and the camera swung: the car sits on a grassy slope below pines, with the tarmac and a large blue puddle to its right, and white posts marking the lane's edge.
decision.hypothesis: The pin is broken and the car is rolling backwards with the lane to its right. A plain W hold should cancel the reverse roll and start forward motion; steering now would waste the momentum.
decision.memory: Plain S (no steering) worked where S+A twice stalled at 0 mph in R. After a successful reverse the camera swings 180-degrees — re-read the lane side before steering.
